verdict.rationale: Vapi's first-party phone quickstart promises creating a voice assistant and talking to it over the phone in under 5 minutes. The assistant quickstart covers connecting it to a phone number and making first calls, with a Customer Support template, system-prompt configuration and a Voice Library for picking a voice. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the time-to-first-live-call claim, detailed evidence of the phone-number provisioning step itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: In under 5 minutes, you'll create a voice assistant and start talking to it over the phone.
Create a voice assistant, connect it to a phone number, and make your first calls.
Browse and preview voices there, then copy a voice's ID to use on an assistant.
Use dynamic variables in the system prompt or any message in the dashboard with double curly braces
